featured_projects.title: AI SaaS Platform
features: Offers AI-powered content generation capabilities leveraging large language models for text generation, summarization, and business workflows.
Includes a subscription management system with Stripe integration, supporting multiple pricing tiers and recurring billing.
Provides a comprehensive administrative dashboard for user management, analytics, usage monitoring, and feature configuration.
Supports a scalable multi-tenant architecture with role-based access control, API rate limiting, and cloud deployment automation.

featured_projects.title: LLM Platform
features: Provides a no-code and low-code environment for building, deploying, and managing LLM-powered applications.
Includes Retrieval-Augmented Generation capabilities with support for knowledge bases, embeddings, and document indexing.
Enables centralized management of multiple AI models, prompts, and application configurations across environments.
Offers enterprise-grade monitoring, analytics, and workflow automation tools for operating AI applications at scale.

featured_projects.title: Agent Engine
features: Provides a framework for building stateful, multi-agent applications with support for complex workflow orchestration.
Enables persistent memory, checkpointing, and recovery mechanisms for long-running AI processes.
Supports tool calling, conditional routing, and human-in-the-loop interactions to improve agent reliability.
Offers reusable components for designing scalable AI systems with modular and maintainable architectures.

featured_projects.title: Coding Assistant
features: Enables AI-driven software engineering workflows including code generation, debugging, refactoring, and documentation creation.
Supports autonomous task execution through tool integrations, shell access, and repository-aware agent capabilities.
Provides compatibility with multiple LLM providers, allowing dynamic model selection based on task requirements.
Includes conversational interfaces and execution environments for iterative problem solving and developer assistance.

collaborative_projects.title: Workspace Hub
features: Delivers a collaborative workspace experience with support for notes, documents, and knowledge management across teams.
Includes rich text editing capabilities with support for tables, media embeds, and customizable content blocks.
Enables real-time synchronization of workspace data across desktop and mobile devices for a seamless user experience.
Provides workspace organization features such as folders, permissions, and project-specific document management.

collaborative_projects.title: Agile Suite
features: Enables end-to-end project management with support for tasks, issues, milestones, and sprint planning workflows.
Provides customizable Kanban boards, roadmaps, and backlog management tools for Agile software development teams.
Includes collaboration features such as comments, notifications, and activity tracking to improve team productivity.
Offers workflow automation and reporting capabilities to monitor project progress and optimize delivery timelines.

collaborative_projects.title: Smart Scheduling
features: Allows users to create personalized booking pages with configurable availability, time zones, and scheduling preferences.
Supports team scheduling, round-robin assignments, and collective event booking for distributed organizations.
Integrates with Google Calendar, Outlook, and Apple Calendar for real-time synchronization.
Provides secure authentication, notifications, and payment integrations for managing appointments and paid consultations.

collaborative_projects.title: Transformer NLP Suite
features: Supports multiple NLP tasks including text classification, question answering, named entity recognition, and language modeling through a unified API.
Provides configurable training pipelines with support for custom datasets, hyperparameter tuning, and experiment tracking.
Includes automated model evaluation and benchmarking capabilities with detailed performance metrics and validation reports.
Enables seamless integration with Hugging Face transformer models for rapid prototyping and production deployment.
